claims.subject: canonical-name

claims.subject: fixed-public-datasets
claims.statement: APT42 was cross-checked against all fixed public datasets; result=matched.
claims.verification_rationale: Matched datasets: etda-threat-group-cards, misp-mitre-intrusion-set, misp-threat-actor. Exact normalized-name matching and aggregation aliases do not prove one-to-one vendor cluster identity. A no-match result records completed searches, not actor nonexistence.

claims.subject: countries
claims.verification_rationale: Evidence tier=repository. Community workbook-only attribution requires independent corroboration.

claims.subject: relationship--apt42--mitre--eb974ffaab685df7
claims.statement: APT42 overlaps-with Charming Kitten: While there are behavior and software overlaps between [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) and [APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044), they appear to be distinct entities and are tracked as separate entities by their originating vendor.
claims.verification_rationale: MITRE relationship extraction: status=supported; A narrative cross-reference establishes a relationship but does not by itself prove exact actor identity or identical scope.
